prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move sign-in to final step after home intro: Move the sign-in step to the very end of onboarding after the home intro, allowing users to experience pet setup friction-free before account creation.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "sign_in"]}
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pet care pledge screen: Insert a short pet care pledge screen right before the adoption certificate to build excitement and emotional commitment.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_pet_pledge", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "adoption_certificate": {"hint": "Confirm your commitment to caring for your new desktop pet."}}
2: [choose_path, new_flow] Path selection quiz flow: Insert an interactive quiz screen before path selection to help users decide which pet path suits them best.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "new_path_quiz", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "choose_path": {"headline": "Find Your Creation Path", "body": "Answer a few quick questions to match with the best creation path."}}
3: [finish, redesign] Two column home intro overview: Redesign the home intro finish screen into a clear two-column layout highlighting essential pet controls and desktop shortcuts.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Meet Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Your pet is now active! Here is how to control, interact, and manage your pet.", "components": [{"type": "text", "text": "Click pet to open options menu", "style": "emphasis"}, {"type": "text", "text": "Drag pet to relocate on screen", "style": "plain"}]}}
4: [adoption, hint] Photo quality setup hint: Add an explicit photo lighting and format tip on the photo upload screen.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "For best pet rendering results, upload clear, well-lit photos with full face visibility."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Generation progress timer and tips: Add a visual completion timer and tip carousel component to the waiting screen while pet assets generate.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Creating Your Desktop Pet", "body": "We are generating your custom desktop animations. This will take just a moment!", "show_time_estimate": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 8, "components": [{"type": "timer", "label": "Estimated build time"}, {"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Tip: You can customize pet behavior anytime from your desktop taskbar."}]}}
6: [sign_in, copy] Account pet recovery explicit reassurance: Update sign-in headline and body text to clearly explain that signing in saves and secures pet data across reinstalls.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Secure Your Pet Data", "body": "Signing in syncs your companion safe to the cloud so your pet is never reset or lost when re-installing."}}
7: [choose_path, layout] Story scroll intro layout: Change the story screen layout to story_scroll for an engaging visual intro before choosing a creation path.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "story_scroll", "headline": "Welcome to Desktop Companions", "body": "Scroll through to see how interactive desktop pets bring your screen to life."}}
8: [adoption, incentive] Official pet parent adoption badge: Display an official pet parent reward badge on the adoption certificate screen upon completing pet customization.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"headline": "Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "body": "Congratulations on completing your companion setup!", "components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Certified Desktop Pet Parent", "style": "playful"}]}}
9: [finish, notification] Desktop updates ready notification: Enable optional desktop notifications on the final home intro screen to keep users informed when features update.
   config: {"home_intro": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "Enable desktop updates to receive new pet interaction guides and companion features."}}

verdicts.reason: Reordering sign-in to the end of onboarding is explicitly permitted by Rule 4.
Adding a new pledge screen within onboarding is allowed and preserves all required steps.
The choose_path screen copy changes its job from offering both adopting and making your own to a quiz prompt.
Redesigning the home_intro layout within onboarding is permitted.
Adding a helpful hint to the photo upload screen is allowed.
Adding a progress timer during a real generation wait is allowed.
Updating sign-in copy to explain data sync is permitted.
Redesigning the story screen layout while continuing to introduce the pet is allowed.
Replacing the official stamp with a playful badge loses the official stamp required for the adoption certificate.
Adding optional desktop notification settings on the home intro screen is allowed.
